


## mission json:
{
  "missionId": "UUID", // generated by the application (hsifa tkifa, mars etc...)
  "missionName": "string", // name of the mission generated by the application (hsifa tkifa, mars etc...)
  "position": {
    "latitude": "double", // latitude of the mission
    "longitude": "double", // longitude of the mission
    "altitude": "double" // altitude of the mission
  },
  "operator_conttext": {
    "stationID": "UUID", // station id of the application (hsifa tkifa, mars etc...)
    "sensorID": "UUID" // sensor id of the sensor from  black lilit
  },
  "timestamp": "string" // timestamp of the mission
}

## camera json:
{
    "sensorID" : "UUID",
    "sensorType" : "Enum", // e.g., "ptz", "cammera", "drone"
    "telemetria" : {
      "latitude" : "float",
      "longitude" : "float",
      "altitude" : "float",
      "speed" : "float",
      "heading" : "float"
    },
    "status": "Enum", // e.g., "active", "inactive", "error"
  }
